items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1961-02-07
items.q: Who else do you say was in that trio? Charlie Love... And Walter Dink, who also read music.

ctx.x: That was in the year of about 1930.

That was at the bungalow? Yeah. Yeah. So when would it be that you were playing at the athletic club? What year would that be? That was during the time of Depression. That was just before that? Depression, yeah. We would get no more than a dollar and a half a nine. That was what you were earning, a dollar and a half? Yeah. A dollar and a half a nine. What was the hours, how long you had to play for? Well, we used to go to work at nine and knock off at two. Oh, yeah, yeah. Nine to two. Who else do you say was in…
Well, no, we didn't play that kind of music over there.
